name: just-code
description: Task board that runs Claude Code on each task in its own branch: approvals on the card, AI review, one-click merge, agent map, continue on your phone

commands.title: JustCode: Use an Anthropic API Key (optional)
JustCode: Install the TASKS.md Sync Skill

justCode.claudePath.description: Path to the claude CLI. Empty: found automatically (PATH, ~/.local/bin, Homebrew, npm global).

enumDescriptions: Claude's safety classifier approves what is safe and asks you only when unsure
File edits are approved; commands outside your rules ask
Every edit and command outside your rules asks on the card
No approvals at all. Only for work you trust

justCode.taskModel.description: Model for tasks (alias like opus, sonnet, haiku, or a full model id). Empty: your Claude default.

justCode.taskEffort.description: How much Claude thinks while building a task. Thinking is billed as output; low is plenty for most tasks. Raise it for hard ones.

justCode.reviewEffort.description: How much the reviewer thinks. Small reviews (see review triage) always use low.

justCode.reviewLightModel.description: Model for reviewing small changes that touch no sensitive code (auth, payments, migrations, config…), when review triage is on. Empty: always the reviewer model.

justCode.reviewTriage.description: Size each review to the change: documentation-only diffs pass without a reviewer, small changes outside sensitive code use the lighter model, everything else the full reviewer.

justCode.allowSubagents.description: Let Claude start subagents inside a task. Each subagent re-sends its own large prompt (~30k tokens per step), which is the single biggest avoidable cost. Off by default; when on, subagents run on Haiku.

justCode.maxParallel.description: Tasks Run all keeps in progress at once. 1: one after another, each building on the previous one's merged work.

justCode.autoReview.description: An AI reviewer checks each finished task, and its issues go back to Claude to fix.

justCode.checks.description: Checks JustCode runs itself after each turn (no tokens): "auto" detects the project's tests and type check (npm/pnpm/yarn/bun, pytest, Django, go, cargo, make); empty turns them off; or list commands, one per line. Failures go back to Claude before the AI review; failures the base branch has too are ignored.

justCode.maxCheckRounds.description: Failing-check rounds sent back to Claude before the task waits for you.

justCode.checkTimeoutMinutes.description: A check running longer than this is stopped and counts as failed.

justCode.folderSetup.description: Gets each task's folder ready before Claude starts: "auto" links node_modules from the project folder when the lockfile matches (installs otherwise) and uses the project's .venv; empty turns it off; or a command to run (e.g. "pnpm install").

justCode.autoMerge.description: Merge automatically when the AI review passes (never when it flags the change critical).

justCode.mergeIfReviewCannotRun.description: With automatic merging on: when the AI review cannot run (it times out or crashes, twice), merge anyway instead of waiting for you. A review that finds issues is never merged this way.

justCode.maxReviews.description: Review rounds before the fix loop stops and waits for you.

justCode.reviewTimeoutMinutes.description: A review still running after this long is stopped.

justCode.reviewCommands.description: Extra command prefixes the reviewer may run (e.g. "make check"). Built in: git read commands, npm/yarn/pnpm/bun scripts, common test and build runners, docker compose exec/run, gradle, adb, playwright, curl.

justCode.allowedTools.description: Rules approved for every task in every project, e.g. "Bash(npm run:*)", "Edit". Each project also keeps the rules you approve with "Always" on a card.

justCode.worktreeCopy.description: Gitignored files copied into each task's copy of the project so its tests can run. They are never committed.

justCode.idleMinutes.description: A task's Claude process that has been idle this long is closed to free memory. It resumes with its full history when needed.

justCode.personalSetup.description: Load your personal Claude setup (plugins, skills, MCP servers, memory, ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md) in every task. Off: tasks load only the project's own setup (your personal allow rules still apply), which saves about 7k tokens on every request.

justCode.freshSessionTokens.description: When a task's session holds more context than this, its review-fix round starts a fresh session from the task's brief, handoff and review notes instead of carrying the whole history. 0: never.
